scope: Proposition 8.12 (Quantitative primitive input bounds) of the manuscript “Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles” (preprints/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 143 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ff8e55372a94e4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 116. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the primitive constructions in Sections 6, 7, and 8, the family requirement in Assumption 4.2 follows from the estimates on common argument boxes proved in those sections. For each fixed finite request their constants and far-regime thresholds depend only on those boxes and margins, the finite field and flag data, and the finite controls in Definition 4.1. The time at which an ordinary test returns to its germ does not enter these constants.
